description: In the wake of repeated supply chain coercion and stalled sovereignty efforts, informal research collectives formed by relocated AI scientists in EU academic hubs begin demonstrating a shared, distributed model evaluation framework that operates outside centralized control structures. This decentralized safety network gains credibility after detecting a critical flaw in a widely used open model, prompting calls for institutional recognition. The development remains grassroots but is gaining momentum as trust in centralized oversight erodes.
